purpose: Advance the conditionally leading split kinetic/mass gate into a bounded action-level derivation, test whether constant Y0 removes the prior kinetic-mixing obstruction, and expose the distinct chi-amplitude degeneration risk without claiming full health, lensing, Solar, or cosmological success.

action_contract.gate_justification: Positive, smooth, exactly differentiable, recovers Z=1 at X=0, shortens the bare/frozen-delta-phi mediator range at high u, and reuses the predecessor gate solely to isolate the effect of moving it from kinetic normalization to the mass term; it does not establish the general coupled range.
action_contract.universal_matter_action: S_m[tilde_g,Psi_matter,Psi_photon] with one non-derivative tilde_g=A(phi,chi)^2*g for every massive and massless species in the minimal branch.
action_contract.forbidden: No independent photon multiplier, photon-only scalar, post-fit lensing rescaling, or derivative-dependent matter metric is present in this package.

eom_and_principal_contract.cross_principal: The second-order blocks P_phichi=P_chiphi=0 exactly because Y_X=0 and the mass gate contains no chi gradient; this does not remove the retained first-derivative mixing on X!=0, chi!=0 backgrounds.
eom_and_principal_contract.first_derivative_mixing: With d=m_chi^2*chi*Z_X, Fourier substitution d_mu->i*k_mu gives off-diagonal entries -i*d*(v.k) in the phi equation and +i*d*(v.k) in the chi equation, up to the frozen common Fourier/Euler sign convention.
eom_and_principal_contract.coupled_local_dispersion: For the frozen constant-coefficient truncation with omitted phi lower-order curvature, D_phi=C*k^2-C_X*(v.k)^2, D_chi=Y0*k^2+m_chi^2*Z, and det(D)=D_phi*D_chi-d^2*(v.k)^2.
derivation_routes: independent linearization of Euler-Lagrange fluxes C*nabla(phi) and Y0*nabla(chi)
eom_and_principal_contract.mass_gate_effect: The prior second-order kinetic derivative cross block is absent, but -Q*Z_X and -Q*Z_XX remain in the phi self-principal tensor and the first-derivative d coupling remains when X and chi are nonzero.

range_and_limits.bare_dispersion: omega^2=k^2+m_chi^2*Z/Y0 only for frozen delta_phi, d*(v.k)=0, or another mixing-vanishing limit; the general local dispersion is det(D)=D_phi*D_chi-d^2*(v.k)^2=0.
range_and_limits.bare_range: ell_bare=sqrt(Y0/Z)/m_chi=sqrt(Y0)/[m_chi*(1+u)] only for frozen delta_phi, d*(v.k)=0, or another mixing-vanishing limit; the full coupled poles are roots of D_phi*D_chi-d^2*(v.k)^2=0.
range_and_limits.high_u_range: In the bare/frozen-phi limit ell_bare~sqrt(Y0)/(m_chi*u); this is not the full coupled range when d*(v.k)!=0.
range_and_limits.X_to_zero: Z->1, Z_X->0, d->0, Z_X+2*X*Z_XX->0, the mixing-vanishing ell_bare->sqrt(Y0)/m_chi, and the gate corrections to both phi principal coefficients vanish
range_and_limits.GR_limit: X->0 alone is not a GR proof. A GR-like limit additionally requires phi and chi stress to be negligible or constant, tilde_g to approach a constant rescaling of g, and the omitted metric equations to approach Einstein gravity.
range_and_limits.high_u_warning: For finite positive asymptotic A0 and B0 on the timelike X>0 branch, chi_max^2 scales as X^-3 and |chi|_max scales as X^-3/2; high-u bare-range screening can therefore coincide with phi-principal degeneration.

necessary_external_scalar_conditions: Z>0 and finite bare/frozen-delta-phi mass parameter m_chi^2*Z/Y0
local_health_contract.timelike_interpretation: For X>0, K is the phi time-kinetic coefficient, C is its spatial-gradient coefficient, and c_phi^2=C/K on the aligned constant jet.
local_health_contract.spacelike_interpretation: For X<0, C is the phi time/transverse coefficient, K is the longitudinal-gradient coefficient, and c_longitudinal^2=K/C on the aligned constant jet.
local_health_contract.timelike_amplitude_bounds: For X>0 with A0>0 and B0>0, C>0 and K>0 require chi^2<min[2*A0/(m_chi^2*Z_X),2*B0/(m_chi^2*H)].
local_health_contract.high_u_amplitude_scaling: For finite positive asymptotic A0,B0, the two chi^2 ceilings approach A0/(2*m_chi^2*beta^2*X^3) and B0/(14*m_chi^2*beta^2*X^3); hence chi_max^2 proportional to X^-3 and |chi|_max proportional to X^-3/2.
local_health_contract.quasistatic_spacelike_bounds: For X<0 with A0>0 and B0>0, Z_X<0 and H<0, so this mass-gate correction increases C and K and imposes no upper chi-amplitude bound from these two inequalities alone; superluminality, energy, cutoff, and metric constraints remain untested.
local_health_contract.boundary_risk: C->0 or K->0 degenerates a principal coefficient. This is a strong-coupling/EFT warning surface, not by itself a proof of the nonlinear strong-coupling scale.

no_go_adjudication.constant_Y_result: For Y=Y0, Y_X=Y_XX=0 and M_Y=0 identically, so the conditional growing-kinetic-gate no-go does not apply.
no_go_adjudication.replacement_risk: The mass gate introduces chi-amplitude-dependent C and K plus retained first-derivative mode mixing d=m_chi^2*chi*Z_X; avoiding the old second-order mixing obstruction does not establish a healthy action.

stress_conservation_and_lensing.scalar_noether_identity: nabla_mu(T^mu_nu)=E_phi*d_nu(phi)+E_chi*d_nu(chi) up to the declared Euler-sign convention; it vanishes for the isolated scalar action on shell.
stress_conservation_and_lensing.with_matter: When S_m depends on phi or chi through one tilde_g, scalar and matter stress tensors exchange energy-momentum; only the total same-action identity is conserved in the Einstein description, while matter is covariantly conserved with respect to tilde_g on its equations.
stress_conservation_and_lensing.same_action_lensing_boundary: Massive matter and photons see the same tilde_g. A conformal tilde_g has the same null curves as g before metric backreaction, so this split scalar action alone supplies no independent lensing enhancement or prediction.
required_future_work: derive metric constraints and the full coupled scalar-metric-matter principal system
solve source-supported on-shell Solar, galaxy, cluster, and cosmological backgrounds
test whether the timelike chi-amplitude bounds are dynamically preserved
compute the EFT cutoff and nonlinear behavior near C=0 or K=0
derive lensing only from the same universal metric solution

machine_check_contract.numeric_parameters: beta=Y0=m_chi=A0=B0=1 and P_XX=0; coupled determinant probes use k^2=1 and (v.k)^2=|X|/2
machine_check_contract.high_u_scaled_limits: X^3*chi_C_max^2->1/2, X^3*chi_K_max^2->1/14, X^(3/2)*|chi_C|max->sqrt(1/2), and X^(3/2)*|chi_K|max->sqrt(1/14) for the frozen unit parameters
